title: Characterization of Increment Overflow
statement: For every binary word $w$, its fixed-width binary increment overflows if and only if $w$ is the all-true word of length $|w|$, including the empty word.
replaced: For every binary word $w$, the fixed-width increment of $w$ overflows if and only if $w$ is the all-ones word of its own length, the empty word included.
